items.title: Your bank's dispute desk
items.when: Use this first. Then allow the timeline for the payment channel.

contacts.note: Use the address shown on the complaint page and check it on your bank's website.

items.message:
Subject: Follow-up on my complaint — {problem_label}

Dear {bank_name},

I am following up on my complaint about a debit of NGN {amount} on {txn_date} at {txn_time} WAT, reference {reference}.

I asked for this to be corrected within {window_hours} hours. Please confirm my ticket number and tell me the current status.

Thank you,
[Your name]

items.title: Your bank's head office complaints unit
items.when: Use this if the bank has not acknowledged your complaint within 3 days, has given no ticket number, or the timeline has passed.
items.message:
Subject: Escalation of unresolved complaint — {problem_label}

Dear Head of Complaints,

I complained to your dispute desk about a debit of NGN {amount} on {txn_date} at {txn_time} WAT, reference {reference}.

The bank has not resolved it within the expected timeline and I do not have a resolution or ticket number. Please escalate this complaint and confirm in writing what happens next.

Thank you,
[Your name]

items.title: CBN Consumer Protection Department
items.when: Use this if the bank misses its timeline or does not acknowledge your complaint. The CBN guide says to complain to the bank first and keep evidence of that. It allows up to two weeks for general complaints.

contacts.value: The Director, Consumer Protection Department, Central Bank of Nigeria, Central Business District, Garki, Abuja
contacts.note: Check this address on the CBN's website before posting.

items.message:
Subject: Complaint against {bank_name} — unresolved debit

Dear Director, Consumer Protection Department,

I complained to {bank_name} about a debit of NGN {amount} on {txn_date} at {txn_time} WAT, reference {reference}.

I did not get a resolution within the bank's timeline. I have kept my complaint and the bank's replies.

Please look into this complaint.

Thank you,
[Your name]
